title: Validation Target Audit
root_cause: Sprint 47 Lane D validated Sprint 46 bundle as a cross-sprint check, then the persisted proof.json recorded that path. Sprint 47's own bundle was built later (Lane F/G) and validated via console output, but no proof artifact was written for it.
tooling_issue: No automated validation-proof generator exists. Proof files are hand-written JSON. No mechanism enforces that the proof names the current sprint's ZIP.
fix_plan: Create a standalone validation function that: (1) takes explicit ZIP path, (2) runs PlannerSprintEvidenceContract.validate_zip(), (3) computes ZIP SHA256, (4) writes proof JSON with all required fields, (5) returns structured result. Add tests that the proof path matches the input path.
stale_path_risk: Without explicit path binding, any validation proof can accidentally name a prior sprint's bundle
